### Fixes
- `image()` and the `image` filter now accept a wikilink to the image, so a property like `PHOTO: "[[Alex Morgan.svg]]"` renders with `{{image(PHOTO)}}` or `{{PHOTO|image}}`. Before, the brackets stayed in the image destination and nothing rendered. Embeds (`![[photo.png]]`), links made with `link()`, and lists of wikilinks work too. Obsidian resolves the file name like any other link. Reported in discussion #14.
- `image()` given a list now renders one image per item, as the `image` filter already did, instead of one broken image.

### Validation
- 1,338 automated tests pass, plus lint, browser typechecking and the production build.
- Mobile was not tested on a device.
